name: sap-test
description: Run from the repo root. Deliberately not a workspace: app/ (Bun) and sap-tests/ (npm + Node, Playwright-SAP aliased as @playwright/test) must keep separate dependency trees, or the fork's @playwright/test alias and the app's own Playwright collide when hoisted.

scripts.setup: bun install --cwd app && cd sap-tests && npm ci && npx playwright install chromium && cd ../app && bunx playwright install chromium
scripts.check: cd app && bun run check && cd ../sap-tests && npm run typecheck
scripts.lint: cd app && bun run lint && cd ../sap-tests && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.lint:light: cd app && bun run lint:light && cd ../sap-tests && npm run lint
scripts.format: cd app && bun run format && cd ../sap-tests && npm run format
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run test:sap:list && bun run test:e2e
